title: Milton Friedman talks about property taxes
summary: A four-minute clip of Milton Friedman, from a 1978 address, discussing property taxes and land value taxation. He says property tax is the least bad tax and explains why it is so unpopular.
why: HN cites it in tax and housing threads as a libertarian economist endorsing property or land taxes.

quote.text: Milton Friedman once commented that property tax is particularly unpopular because it's the only tax for which people still have to write a check
